Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this time expression is not natural in narrative Chinese; use the established form for a historical setting.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 靠墓地的家：靠近墓地的房子里，use a location phrase with a noun such as “house,” and use “inside the house” after the verb for a natural place expression.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孩子搬家，when a mother moves together with her child, this expression shows that she takes the child with her; the original wording incorrectly treats the child as an equal companion in the moving action.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，use this word for “another city”; the original word is used to distinguish other people or things from a specifically mentioned one.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子才五岁：他才五岁，use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence because the boy was just introduced as “孟子” in the previous sentence.
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：在一个城市里，this is the first mention of a city, so use an indefinite full noun phrase rather than a demonstrative that refers to an unintroduced place.
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence of the same character; the name has already appeared earlier in the sentence.
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 住了在：住在，use the zero particle for a background living state; “了” does not fit an ongoing state here.
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，use the zero particle for a routine action marked by “每天.”
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬了到：搬到了，put “了” after the full verb-complement “搬到” to mark the completed move.

items.reason: “古代的时候” redundantly combines two time expressions, whereas “在古代” is correct.
“靠墓地的家” needs the more natural location expression “靠近墓地的房子里.”
“跟孩子搬家” is a valid way to say that she moved house together with her child.
For an additional or another city, “另外一个/另一个城市” is required rather than “别一个城市.”
“孩子” is vague here, while “他” clearly refers back to the recently introduced 孟子.
The city has not previously been introduced, so “那个城市” lacks a clear antecedent.
孟母 has just been mentioned in the same sentence, so the close re-reference should use “她.”
“住了在” has incorrect particle placement, but the displayed correction “住在” is incomplete without a location.
A habitual action marked by “每天” should not take perfective “了.”
“了” must follow the verb-complement in “搬到了,” but the displayed correction remains incomplete without its destination.
